_meta.note: COMMITTABLE TEMPLATE. Copy to config/providers.json (gitignored) and fill in your own determinations. Every provider here is disabled and every commercial_use_confirmed is false, so a fresh clone generates nothing until you decide otherwise -- verify.sh asserts that. The endpoints, api_shapes and models for the three hf_* / huggingface routes were verified against live calls on 2026-08-16 and are correct as written; what is NOT filled in for you is the licence determination.
_meta.keys_note: A 'keys' entry names an ENVIRONMENT VARIABLE -- never the credential itself. Values live in .env (chmod 600, gitignored). Rotator.from_files() refuses to start if a value here looks like a credential.
_meta.commercial_use_warning: commercial_use_confirmed is skipped-unless-true by the rotator. It is your determination to record, made after reading BOTH the model licence and the service terms. Where it is true below, licence_notes still needs replacing with what was actually checked.

output_spec.note: Generate at the provider's best native size in 5:6 (e.g. 848x1024 or 1016x1216 -- 8px grid, within 1% of 5:6). 832x1024 is 2.5% off 5:6 and image QA rejects it. Do NOT ask for 4500x5400 directly. Upscale happens in the vectorize stage.

hf_nscale.licence_notes: NOT YOUR DETERMINATION YET. Read the model licence AND the service terms, then record here what you actually read. FLUX.1-schnell weights are apache-2.0 (Hub model card); the HF Inference Providers terms and nscale's own terms are separate and unread. Returns lossless PNG at the requested size.
hf_nscale.route_note: Shares one real token with hf_together and huggingface. The ledger tracks them as separate provider:key pairs, so a quota wall is discovered once per route rather than once per account.

hf_together.licence_notes: NOT YOUR DETERMINATION YET. Read the model licence AND the service terms, then record here what you actually read. Same apache-2.0 FLUX.1-schnell weights as hf_nscale, but this route returns JPEG -- lossy, so prefer it as fallback only.

pollinations.licence_notes: NOT YOUR DETERMINATION YET. Read the model licence AND the service terms, then record here what you actually read. Unverified.

cloudflare.licence_notes: NOT YOUR DETERMINATION YET. Read the model licence AND the service terms, then record here what you actually read. FLUX.1-schnell weights are apache-2.0 but Cloudflare's service terms are separate -- verify both.

gemini.licence_notes: NOT YOUR DETERMINATION YET. Read the model licence AND the service terms, then record here what you actually read. Image generation is quota 0 on the free tier and the API offers no 5:6 aspect ratio (nearest 4:5 is 4% off and fails image QA), so this needs billing AND a pad-to-5:6 step before the licence question even matters. build_request refuses this api_shape outright for that reason -- enabling it here will not produce an image.

together.licence_notes: NOT YOUR DETERMINATION YET. Read the model licence AND the service terms, then record here what you actually read. Unverified. Direct Together API, not the HF router.

huggingface.licence_notes: NOT YOUR DETERMINATION YET. Read the model licence AND the service terms, then record here what you actually read. stabilityai/stable-diffusion-3-medium-diffusers is license 'other' (Stability Community Licence -- revenue-capped, conditional) and gated on the Hub. Weaker terms than the apache-2.0 routes above, and the output is compressed JPEG.
